scripts.test:data-finding: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs/promises'; import('./omega_country_semantic_bridge.js'); import('./omega_resource_semantic_bridge.js'); import('./omega_ai_context_bridge.js'); const bridge=globalThis.OmegaCanonicalIdentityRegistry||globalThis.OmegaCountrySemanticBridge; await bridge.init(); const rows=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile('countries.json','utf8')); const failures=[]; for(const row of rows){const expected=String(row?.code||'').trim().toUpperCase();const name=String(row?.name||'').trim();const direct=bridge.resolveCountry(name);if(!expected||!name||String(direct?.id||'').toUpperCase()!==expected)failures.push({name,expected,actual:direct?.id||null,stage:'DIRECT_NAME'});} const ctx=globalThis.OmegaCanonicalAIContextBridge; if(!ctx?.discoverCountry)failures.push({stage:'QUESTION_DISCOVERY_API',reason:'discoverCountry unavailable'}); else for(const row of rows){const name=String(row?.name||'').trim();const expected=String(row?.code||'').trim().toUpperCase();const hit=await ctx.discoverCountry('What is '+name);if(!hit?.id||String(hit.id).toUpperCase()!==expected){failures.push({name,expected,actual:hit?.id||null,stage:'QUESTION_DISCOVERY'});if(failures.length>50)break;}} const dfs=globalThis.OmegaDataFindingSystem; if(!dfs)failures.push({stage:'DATA_FINDING'}); else {const d=await dfs.init(); if(!d?.ready)failures.push({stage:'DATA_FINDING_NOT_READY'});} if(failures.length){console.error(JSON.stringify({ok:false,countryRows:rows.length,failures:failures.slice(0,50)},null,2));process.exit(1);} console.log('OMEGA DATA FINDING TEST PASSED'); console.log('Country records audited:',rows.length); console.log('Question entity resolution: PASS'); console.log('Context discovery resolution: PASS');"
